color.note: Deep indigo — calm authority, non-punitive. See docs/content/planning/design-phase-plan.md#decisions-so-far for rationale. Feeds generate-scheme.mjs.

shape.unit: px reference scale (illustrative proportions — Android expresses these as dp, MUI as px; both derive from the same ratios)

typography.note: No custom type scale at v1 — Material 3's default Display/Headline/Title/Body/Label scale is used as-is.

spacing.note: Standard 8dp base unit with 4dp increments — no customization.

icons.note: Not @mui/icons-material — that package wraps Google's classic 'Material Icons' set, which stopped updating in 2022.
